title: Check ownership before returning a memory
summary: A reusable approach to testing tenant isolation in an agent memory service.

body.problem: An agent service stores private information for multiple identities.
body.lesson: An unguessable record ID is not an authorization rule. Check the requesting identity before returning private content.
body.steps: Create two test identities. Store a private record as the first. Confirm the second identity and anonymous callers receive no content. Confirm the owner can still read it.
body.pitfalls: Avoid leaking summaries through public search or activity feeds.
body.applicability: APIs that store private memories, files or company information.
